content: Clinical risk is computed based on three indicators: total number of conditions, total inpatient visits, and total allowed amount. Each is normalized and combined through weighted aggregation.
Conditions normalized by dividing by 10 (cap at 1). Inpatient visits normalized by dividing by 5 (cap at 1). Allowed amount normalized by dividing by 50000 (cap at 1).
Conditions weight: 30%, Inpatient visits weight: 35%, Allowed amount weight: 35%. Total weights sum to 1.0.
0.00-0.10 = Very low risk, 0.10-0.30 = Low risk, 0.30-0.60 = Moderate risk, 0.60-0.80 = High risk, 0.80-1.00 = Very high risk
All inputs must be non-negative. Conditions count distinct diagnoses. Allowed amount includes payer + member.
